aggregate_gain: equal-log mean across four primary contexts, block-paired; upper<1 and >=11/15wins vs both controls
counter_protocol: 12 whole-process grouped cycles/instructions/cache-misses/branch-misses, >=90% coverage; n=2^24; fixed setup/export included, not inversion-exclusive cycles
driver_caveats: four-stream array loop is rolled, not four products resident; fused c/d invariant allows preprocessing hoist; timed interval includes initialization/pack/export
interval: paired order statistics 4th/8th/12th of 15; central median interval 96.484375% under independent stationary blocks; not family-wise inference
ordering: case rotation/block reversal; role rotation/block reversal within case
output_checks: all equal case/block/role hashes and profile/stat outputs at their own equal rounds; no component output is a proof
owned_concurrent_work: none during capture; no build/hash/archive/analysis/second workload
primary_gain: all4 Fq/R256 contexts candidate/both-controls upper<1 and >=11/15 wins; no minimum gain floor
profile_protocol: 12 whole-process cycles:u at period2M, n=2^26, >=1000 samples, <=5% unknown, zero LOST, PID/TID/MMAP+CPU2 and >=95% samples in target kernel; no extension/pilot
scope: primitive screen only, not full callers/proofs/memory peak/mobile/AWS; a loss closes this fixed recipe without favorable subset, not all pairwise algorithms
